text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prevailing over a fierce battle to claim 
1st place was <chrname>— Finally, a Japanese 
Umamusume has conquered this grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having launched the project for those 
chasing romance, Mei Satake's eyes also 
grew moist with a flood of deep emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the great achievement brought by <chrname> 
began to spread and transform into 
fighting spirit toward the next dream.
